title: Weaves, Wires, and Morphisms: Formalizing and Implementing the Algebra of Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.07242v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite deep learning models running well-defined mathematical functions, we lack a formal mathematical framework for describing model architectures. Ad-hoc notation, diagrams, and pseudocode poorly handle nonlinear broadcasting and the relationship between individual components and composed models. This paper introduces a categorical framework for deep learning models that formalizes broadcasting through the novel axis-stride and array-broadcasted categories. This allows the mathematical function underlying architectures to be precisely expressed and manipulated in a compositional manner. These mathematical definitions are translated into human manageable diagrams and machine manageable data structures. We provide a mirrored implementation in Python (pyncd) and TypeScript (tsncd) to show the universal aspect of our framework, along with features including algebraic construction, graph conversion, PyTorch compilation and diagram rend

translated_title: 编织、连线与态射：深度学习代数的形式化与实现
translated_abstract: 尽管深度学习模型运行着定义良好的数学函数，我们仍缺乏用于描述模型架构的正式数学框架。临时记号、图表和伪代码难以妥善处理非线性广播以及单个组件与组合模型之间的关系。本文引入了一个用于深度学习模型的范畴论框架，通过新颖的轴步长（axis-stride）和数组广播（array-broadcasted）范畴形式化了广播机制。这使得架构背后的数学函数能够以组合的方式被精确表达和操作。这些数学定义被转化为人类可管理的图表和机器可管理的数据结构。我们提供了Python（pyncd）和TypeScript（tsncd）中的镜像实现，以展示我们框架的通用性，并包括代数构造、图转换、PyTorch编译和图表渲染等功能。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于范畴论的深度学习架构形式化框架，通过轴步长和数组广播范畴实现广播机制的组合化表达，并提供了跨语言的实现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a categorical framework for deep learning architectures that formalizes broadcasting via novel axis-stride and array-broadcasted categories, enabling compositional expression and manipulation, with cross-language implementations.
